risks.title: Dependence on Consumer Spending and Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in the 'Risks Related to Our Business' section with strong language ('could reduce demand', 'adversely impacted'). It is contextualized by current economic conditions, inflation, and geopolitical pressures, increasing its severity.

risks.title: Global Supply Chain and Logistics Risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with numerous examples (transit delays, increased costs, natural disasters, geopolitical instability). Intense language ('disrupt our business', 'negatively impact') underscores its severity.

risks.title: Increased Competition in Highly Competitive Market
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly stated as a key factor ('Our industry is highly competitive') with negative impacts on sales and strong language ('negatively impact our sales').

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Fraud Risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is placed in a dedicated section ('Risks Related to Technology') with strong terms ('cybersecurity risks and costs', 'credit card fraud, identity theft and business interruption'). Potential consequences are significant.

risks.title: Inventory Management and Order Fulfillment
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned repeatedly ('manage our inventory and timely and effectively deliver merchandise', 'manage our order-taking and fulfillment operations') with impacts on results and reputation.

risks.title: Dependence on Global Suppliers
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the section dedicated to suppliers and global operations, highlighting dependence on product quantity, price, and quality.

risks.title: Omni-Channel and Multi-Brand Operations Complexity
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in the context of increasing business complexity ('omni-channel and multi-brand business'). Failure to manage it could lead to declines.

ai_positioning.summary: WSM mentions the use of artificial intelligence in its supply chain and customer service operations. The company plans to expand the use of AI and advanced analytics to improve inventory visibility, stock levels, and service times, as well as to optimize engineering, customer service, and creative operations.
evidence: We plan to continue to optimize and automate our distribution centers and logistics network, supported by expanded use of artificial intelligence (AI) and advanced analytics
expected AI-enabled efficiencies across engineering, customer care and creative functions to drive earnings
